subject: doc
title: DOC.------(R)INFO.TRNS.
description: Diagram in WAC-27, the second on book p229. (C)DOC — the *concept* of documentation — is crossed with (R)INFO-TRNS — the *reality* of information transference. The (c) on documentation and the (r) on information-transference are deliberately paired: Braxton is asking what the concept of documentation actually does to the reality of information transference, a structurally fraught pairing in a section about how Euro-American composers' work was documented (or wasn't) by the European defining community. DOC outputs to PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics), INFO-TRNS (the crossing), and POL-DYM (political dynamics). POL-DYM branches to GRAD (gradualism) → SOC-RT (social reality), and to MT-INFO (music information). A separate chain runs AFL-DY (affinity dynamics) → EXT-FT (extended functionalism), with EXT-FT branching to (R)MPT (the reality of manipulation) and PR-TRS (primary transition, a diagram-only compound). Structural argument: the concept of documentation reaches social reality and music information only via political dynamics, with gradualism as the social-reality intermediary — the very mechanism Braxton has identified as the western device for absorbing-and-defanging alternative work. The affinity-dynamics→extended-functionalism→manipulation/primary-transition sub-chain runs in parallel, encoding *how* extended functionalism connects to manipulation as a real outcome.
